discoveries: (1) Policy 2 (c) is hard-coded to `w2/integrate` and silently refuses nothing elsewhere (F-12, fails open, feature-gated); (2) a failed restore mislabelled "reverted" passes all 1,357 containment cases (PF-7, F-6); (3) W2-58's live sessions run in every close's parallel phase (F-2); (4) two wall-clock limits went red under load for the first time: W1-02's 5 s bound, which 168 cases assert, and the guard's 20 s deadline (F-14); (5) DEC-769 item 3 is missing from W2-21's ticket while 5 tests pin the old rule (F-4); (6) the decisions Policy 2 replaced carry no "Changed by" mark (F-3); (7) DEC-892's network check probes from outside the sandbox, about 40 to 60 minutes before the session runs (F-1).
risks: F-12 switches off Policy 2 (c) for the test designer in any repository without `w2/integrate` (EXAMIN's adoption, Wave 3); F-6 is a latent false "reverted" label; load-caused reds (the p95 cases, F-14) keep turning lead verifications red and can refuse closes until W2-57's resource gate; W1-46's host cases can still refuse a close on the network.
lessons: on this machine, timing tests fail at an outside load of about one per core even when run alone; planted faults confirmed the weak verdicts and found one the scan missed (PF-5); the close queue held the machine for about 5 of my 10 hours, so my batches had to stop at a lock and resume.
